D-DAY! ✨

We can’t wait to see you later, Carats, and make more unforgettable memories together with SEVENTEEN and our fellow Carats! 💎

Catch special performances by HYVEN, enjoy games and activities, win raffle prizes, and so much more!

Let’s celebrate 11 wonderful years of SEVENTEEN at Ali Mall, Araneta City! Registration and the stamp rally will start at 12 noon.

If you haven’t registered online yet, you can still join and register as a walk-in later! See you there!

This event is in partnership with Ali Mall, Araneta City !
